voices.name: Bunty - Funny Best Friend
voices.description: Bunty’s voice is full of charm, wit, and best-friend energy—ideal for funny reels, roast-style rants, relatable meme content, and banter-led storytelling. With a naturally desi tone and perfect comic timing, his voice feels like your everyday buddy pulling your leg, making it perfect for creators, meme pages, and short-form comedy content on social media platforms.

voices.name: Jesse - Elearning, Casual Friendly Male
voices.description: This is a warm, casual, and friendly male voice designed specifically for eLearning and online courses. This voice has a natural conversational tone that feels approachable and engaging, perfect for explaining concepts, guiding learners, and keeping students interested without sounding formal or robotic. The voice is clear and easy to listen to for long training modules, tutorials, and educational content. This is the voice of a relatable male narrator.

voices.name: Will - Deep, Smooth and Affectionate
voices.description: Narration voice for Brazilian children, with a friendly and warm touch. Designed to capture the attention of children, it has smooth and expressive intonations. Ideal for audiobooks, children's stories, and educational content.

voices.name: Donovan - Articulate, Strong and Deep
voices.description: A hard-boiled voice that accepts no nonsense but feels deeply. A voice of caring authority who will stick with you to the end.

voices.name: Monika Sogam - Premium Hindi Commercial
voices.description: Polished, expressive and unmistakably premium — Monika Sogam's commercial voice commands attention from the very first word. Her refined Hindi delivery brings brand campaigns, FMCG ads, product launches, OTT commercials, and brand activations to life with the kind of presence that makes every ad impossible to skip. With over 10 billion characters generated, Monika Sogam is one of ElevenLabs' most celebrated voices — and this profile represents her at her most powerful.
